verdict.rationale: Vanta explicitly markets an ISO 27001 product with automated evidence collection, ISMS templates, and certification support (vanta-docs-18, vanta-docs-39, vanta-docs-50), and generic cross-framework mapping (vanta-docs-12, vanta-docs-25) suggests control-level tracking. However, none of the evidence names the Annex A control set specifically, nor documents a Statement of Applicability artifact or certification-audit-specific deliverables — the framework is treated like other frameworks generically rather than shown as a first-class, audit-artifact-rich ISO 27001 implementation. missing for 10: explicit Annex A control catalog, Statement of Applicability generation/export, ISO-specific certification audit workflow/artifacts, independent corroboration of ISO cert success.
